title: Red Balloons Keep Appearing On My Window #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine a red balloon is tied to your window. The card says "Happy birthday."
Next morning, two balloons. Then four. Then ten.
By Friday, your whole window is red. Your room glows red all night.
At midnight, you hear squeaking. Like someone rubbing a balloon.
You pull back the curtain. Every balloon has a smiley face.
And they're all slowly turning. Like heads.
*One pops. Behind it, there's an eye. Looking straight at you.
You scream. Mum runs in and rips the curtain open. Nothing. Clean glass.
"Bad dream," she says, and kisses your head.
Then you see the red string. Tied around her wrist.
